sources.benches/profiling/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "stable-json-rs-profiling"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2024"
publish = false

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]

[dependencies]
napi = { version = "=3.14.2", default-features = false, features = ["napi8", "dyn-symbols"] }
napi-derive = "=3.6.12"
serde = "=1.0.229"
serde_json = { version = "=1.0.154", features = ["raw_value"] }
memchr = "=2.8.3"
encoding_rs = "=0.8.42"
stats_alloc = { version = "=0.1.10", optional = true }

[features]
alloc-profile = ["dep:stats_alloc"]

[[bin]]
name = "allocations"
required-features = ["alloc-profile"]

[build-dependencies]
napi-build = "=2.6.0"

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
